presetNotes:
Since arch glacor is a fairly random fight, with each fight giving completely attack rotations, I will not be giving a ability by ability guide. I will instead be giving general advice and what you want each attack to look like.
Switch to spirit shield right before being hit by attacks for 30% and less damage, and use the elder overload salve to restore prayer. While normal prayers are rather risky to bring, especially at age with arms and minions, I have found with mages sustain and likelyhood to crit, it is fairly safe and consistent. Unfortutly for you zealot ammy only buffs the separate prayers like mystic might, but with melee am hej is better then zealot meaning we will have to do a lot of prayer switching, and when we spec with a EoF you want to switch to the single stronger prayer for both melee and mage.

Remember to prepot overload, kwuarm and lantadyme inceanse sticks, and powder of penance and protection. On a dummy in wars retreat use a dragon baxe spec then get back to full adren. Remember to store a master magic cape on the skillcape rack for double the time of curse spells such as enfeeble.

For cannon deactive prayer, use vengeance, repriasal, vit burst, reflect, freedom and for the final hit use resonance, with this method you will heal most of the damage you receive, while also recoiling up to 60k damage. If wanting to be safer or if you get a back to back cannon instead use anticipate, debilitate or reflect or even shield dome if it is at 50% block, then use protect mage for the first 2 hits, for the third use resonance, if resonance is on cooldown use preparation for the first 2 hits which should bring resonance of cooldown.

For flury it is recommended use pulverize so we don't take to much damage, make sure enfeeble is active. Try to use either debilitate or reflect, shield dome may also be used, even if it is at 25%. With spirit shield flicks this is not strictly necessary. If hp is a major problem disruption shield can help tank some damage. If you feel you have enough time before cannons and it's off cooldown you can use a resonance or if hp is fine divert, after doing either be sure to use preparation to make sure it is ready for cannon.


For minions use debiliate on bolstered glacyte, or shield dome which will block all damage not just the bolstered but will scale its defense down, minions can be done with 25% dome but 50% is much safer. You want to do this since we will be both taking more damage and be unable to easily spirit shield flick. If it is off cooldown and think it will be off cooldown before cannon or you feel safer debilitating cannon, you can elect to use a reflect.

For melee minions you should already have built some bloodlust stacks knowing it could be minions, equip tumekens light use its spec then use adaptive to get adren back and a bloodlust stack then hurricane, as long as it hits all minions plus ag and you had 4 bloodlust it should completely reset the cooldown therefore allowing us to use a second cane. After this use rend, adaptive then chaos roar to get back up to 4 stacks, in this time cane will come off cooldown allowing use to use another cane into cane immediately.

For arms I don't have an exact rotation. It will look fairly similar to minions, you can also just improvise with strong damaging attacks, I would say as far and damaging attacks go, arms is on the highest priority, meaning no attack is to precious for arms. If maging make sure you have sunshine active and FSoA spec, and have 100% adren before it starts. For melee make sure you have a fair few bloodlust stacks and having berserk active is absolutely critical, if you think it might run out of time in the middle of arms, do a early switch to mage and use a adren pot and if need be devotion. You should not use ezk as it kinda sucks without flamebound rival, and using flame bound rival on arms is a atrocious idea, it not only clears as soon as you kill but also clears it from ag and uses the full cooldown.

Surprisingly we rarely need devotion, with powder of protection and spirit shield flicks we are taking fairly low damage from auto attacks, and we will usually be clearing arms before it is needed, however it is recommended to still save it, using it only when life or death, it is better to try to recoil damage and deal it back then it is to not take the damage.

Berserk is a rather risky skill to use for AG, it cannot be used for cannon or else you take way to much damage. For arms and minions if you don't get a proper fast clear then you will take a lot of damage, and you will probably get a slow clear if you are trying to use berserk reactionary, as you will have very little adren to start, so it is really only safe if you have already gotten cannon and can use it while still getting your adren back before the attack. It is very safe to use during beams but you won't be able to take full effect of it with beams do to you being out of attack range during it. For flurry you can use it relatively safely thanks to things like powder of protection and flamebound rival make you take a minumal amount of damage.
